<ApiTitle method="get" title="List Bulk Batch Jobs" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/turbosign/bulk/batch/{batchId}/jobs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a page of the jobs in a batch, one per document, with each job's status, the created signature document ID once sent, and any error. Batch-wide job counts are included and ignore the filters.
